small_guidance:
- Switch to channels_last memory layout for x and weight so the IC loop's loads coalesce; even better, tile over OC (currently BLOCK_OC=16 covers all OC at once — fine, but try BLOCK_SP=64/128 with num_warps=8 paired with prefetched weight tiles).
- The 27 kernel positions are static_range-unrolled; precompute the (id_, ih, valid_d, valid_h) outside the kw loop and only iterate kw inside the inner pw loop. Currently the (id_, ih) computation is hoisted but reload of w_vals happens 27× per ic — consider loading the full (KD,KH,KW,OC) weight slab for one ic into registers/shared once.
- Add autotune configs with BLOCK_SP=128/256 and num_stages=4 to better hide the strided x-loads.
large_guidance:
- Recast as an explicit GEMM: treat (N·POD·POH·POW) as M, OC as N, IC·KD·KH·KW as K (with K=81 here being small). Use tl.dot with BLOCK_M=64, BLOCK_N=16, BLOCK_K=32 and let tensor cores do the MAC. The im2col gather for ConvTranspose-with-pool is the same index math but the inner accumulate becomes a real matmul.
- Consider a scatter-add formulation: one program per (n, ic, id, ih, iw_tile) computing input × weight outer product and atomically adding into the pooled output (dividing by 8 in the epilogue). For batch=128, IC=3, this gives more parallel programs than the current gather scheme.
